basic_info.description: Wake up to jaw-dropping, panoramic vistas of the San Francisco Bay in the heart of Russian Hill. Sip coffee from your private deck while enjoying postcard views of the water, Alcatraz, and the ferris wheel. Or, soak up the spectacles of downtown SF, Coit Tower, and the Bay Bridge from your second private deck, off the primary suite. Constructed in 2000 with meticulous attention to detail, this top-floor condo features a spacious, light-filled floor plan, crafted for elevated everyday living and sophisticated entertaining (with a BBQ included!). Modern conveniences include in-unit laundry, AC, ample storage, and TWO car parking, yet HOA dues remain low. The prime location invites you to embrace the vibrant San Franciscan life from Irish coffees at Buena Vista to indulgent dinners at Michelin-starred Gary Danko to fresh seafood dinners overlooking the Golden Gate Bridge at Scomas. When you're cooking at home, the shared backyard features fruit trees for a farm-to-table dinner. Welcome to your dream home, where every day (both in AND out of your home) is an extraordinary adventure!
